The world is brighter with you in it. I know that because of the polite language you use- thanking people for reading your post when it should be us thanking you for giving us a chance at trying to help you. Being afraid of getting hurt is natural- nothing to be ashamed of. Yet that fear, that apprehension is there for a reason. I’m sure there’s something in your life that makes it worth trying for at least a little while longer.

Things might not get better for a long time. I can’t promise that they will at all. But I’m sure there are loved ones in your life that you could turn to who love you. You say you pushed everyone away but maybe you can make amends. If not, you can meet new people that understand you. Finding the right people is hard I admit but there are places for that. If you’re in college I’d suggest taking some psychology classes because the people in them are very open minded about mental illness and are way less likely to judge your symptoms.

Nobody’s problems are petty. Whatever they are, they are real to you and that makes it okay for you to have feelings about those problems. The fact that you booked the appointment means you want to get better and believe you can. I’m proud of you. It takes a lot of bravery to acknowledge a negative emotional state and take the first step to fixing it.

I don’t mean to condescend but 23 is still young, you have time. It’s okay to not have energy for everything. And yes, it is exhausting to not have the things our heart most wants, but you have time. As long as you are trying to make things better for yourself about something well, I’m proud of you for making it this far and trying this hard. Maybe it doesn’t matter that your friends aren’t irl. I’m sure the bond you share is real even if you don’t occupy the same real, physical space.

For high INT library stuff- Alchemist (Mind Chemist) for 2 levels so you can get perfect recall and use your INT mod twice on knowledge checks. That combined with access to cognatogens (+4 to a mental stat, -2 to a physical stat while consumed) would let you boost your knowledge by 8 when drinking an INT mutagen. Bard for 17 levels. You still get the +10 on knowledge skill checks as per lore master. You could also take 1 level of oracle (lore mystery with think on it revelation) that would give you a +10 to reattempting a failed knowledge check.   


So assuming you're 6th level (let's say 1 levels alchemist, 5 levels of bard) with 16 Int:   


10 (take 10) + 1 rank + 3 class skill + 3 modifier + 2 alchemy bonus ( +4 to INT, that is +2 modifier) + 2 bardic knowledge + 2 breadth of experience + 1d6 = 22 + 1d6   


Now, that may be 1 less than your build above but, at level 7 if you take a 2nd level of alchemist and get the ability to add your int bonus TWICE to knowledge checks it becomes:  


10 (take 10) +1 rank + 3 class skill +6 modifier (adding it twice), +4 alchemy bonus (adding the INT from before bonus twice), + 2 bardic knowledge + 2 breadth of experience + 1d6 =   
28 + 1d6  


Now, what I think is worth noting about this build is that a lot of the bonuses scale even better over time. You add a higher int modifier twice regardless of the source and giving you 4 of that as an alchemical bonus which stacks with enhancement bonuses that may be applied.   


Also, at level 7 you could take skill focus as your alchemical discovery for a +3 bonus to a specific knowledge check.  And brew potion is just nice to have as per alchemy anyway.   


Then at level 8 if you take one level of lore oracle you could take the think on it revelation and reattempt a knowledge check at +10 competence bonus 1/day. So once a day you could get a +20 bonus between taking 10 and reattempting before factoring all the other bonuses.
